_meta.description: Hardwired prevention rules — extracted from ZF-Cycle audit findings. APPEND ONLY. These rules apply before any new code is written.
_meta.enforcement: HARDWIRED — every scope implementation must pass all ACTIVE rules before the scope is considered complete.

rules.label: Authentication before handler
rules.statement: Before writing any new route handler: declare and wire the authentication middleware. The handler is always the SECOND thing. Auth middleware is FIRST.
rules.check: Does the route have auth middleware declared before it processes any business logic?

rules.label: Injection scan on every string input round
rules.statement: scanForInjection() must be called on EVERY string input received from any actor — including secondary rounds (clarification_response, follow-up submissions, webhook payloads).
rules.check: Does every endpoint that receives string input from actors call scanForInjection()?

rules.label: No synchronous file I/O on hot paths
rules.statement: No readFileSync() or writeFileSync() calls in any request handler on the hot path (classify, clarify, session/open). These are thread-blocking and cause cascading latency under load.
rules.check: Are there any readFileSync/writeFileSync calls in route handlers? If yes: FAIL.
rules.enforcement: TRACKED — Phase 0.5 PostgreSQL migration resolves this

rules.label: Governance records are append-only
rules.statement: Classification Records (CR-IDs) are governance audit trail entries. They CANNOT be overwritten after creation. updateRecord() that overwrites classification_result, q1_type, or q4_status is PROHIBITED. State changes must be stored as separate events.
rules.check: Does any code overwrite classification fields on an existing CR? If yes: FAIL.
rules.enforcement: ACTIVE — updateRecord() callers must migrate to event model

rules.label: Every rule checks a live source
rules.statement: No rule may pass or fail based on a hardcoded value (true/false constant). Every rule must query a live source — file, DB, or registry. Stubs must be marked MOCK_MODE in responses.
rules.check: Does every rule read from a live data source, not a constant? If any constant: FAIL unless MOCK_MODE is flagged.
rules.enforcement: PARTIAL — RULE-PARK now reads park-registry.json; RULE-GOAL/RAT/VOC still use hardcoded values

rules.label: Every result must include actionable next-step
rules.statement: Every classification result returned to a user must tell them specifically what to do next — not just what the system decided. BLOCKED must say: 'To fix this, do X.' HELD must say: 'Contact Governor by [date].' The UX must direct, not report.
rules.check: Does every result state have an actionable human-readable next step? Vague routing strings do not count.

history.notes: DATA-002 closed — updateRecord() removed, storeClassificationEvent() wired. P4-APPEND-ONLY now mechanically enforced.
SEC-002 + SEC-007 closed — authMiddleware wired across all 19 /api/* routes. Bearer token required, route-tier enforced. P1-AUTH-FIRST now mechanical.
GOV-BOUNDARY-002 + GOV-BOUNDARY-003 closed — Q1 deterministic tree (12 nodes, 3 confidence tiers) and Q2 domain-aware tree replace AI inference. Same input = same type. Always.
